onePageSummary: ‘Earth — Our Shared Home’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects Earth as a shared home, land water and air as connected systems, movement across places, human impact, shared responsibility. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
